step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified client actor (Mobile/PC) initiating rendering request.
2. Visualized API Gateway receiving requests and invoking the Frontend Lambda.
3. Tracked request flow from Frontend Lambda through Request SQS queue to EC2 Auto Scaling workers.
4. Identified response flow from EC2 Auto Scaling through Response SQS queue back to Frontend Lambda and returning playlist URL to Client.
5. Connected Client to CloudFront, which pulls video segments stored in S3 by EC2 Auto Scaling.
6. Mapped bottom scaling feedback loop: Step Functions triggers Scaling Lambda using CloudWatch metrics to scale EC2 Auto Scaling.
7. Mapped spot interruption loop: CloudWatch Events triggers Spot Interruption Lambda to manage EC2 Auto Scaling instance draining.

nodes.notes: Rendering engine running on spot instances across AZs

nodes.name: CloudWatch / Events
nodes.notes: Collects metrics and emits spot interruption notices

edges.notes: API Gateway forwards request to Lambda
Lambda pushes rendering instructions to request queue
EC2 engine pulls jobs from request queue
EC2 engine responds immediately to response queue
Frontend Lambda polls response queue for job confirmation
Lambda returns playlist link to client
EC2 engine uploads rendered video segments to S3
CloudFront fetches video segments from S3 origin
Step Functions triggers scaling Lambda periodically
EC2 instances push metrics to CloudWatch
Scaling Lambda adjusts capacity in Auto Scaling group
CloudWatch Event triggers Lambda on spot interruption notice
Lambda instructs instance to drain and detach from ASG
